cohort: Multiparous women giving birth in hospital with a singleton after 20 weeks in Ontario from 2012 to 2014
finding: Associations of preterm birth with cesarean section, low Apgar score, and neonatal death varied across clinical conditions but were similar between first and recurrent preterm births.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher for both first and recurrent preterm births associated with maternal, fetal, and placental conditions.
